decisions.reason: As an established flagship line closely tied to the firm’s core glass-processing capabilities and stated move into higher-value applications, management is very unlikely to withdraw it after already investing in and publicly backing it, especially in a growing R&D-driven context.

Although newer, this product was launched prominently as a next-generation semiconductor solution aligned with the firm’s strategic direction, so management would tend to continue supporting it and interpret any early market uncertainty as temporary rather than grounds for exit.
